issues.description: Q7: beliefs is the blank target, but 'those beliefs' appears later in the passage. However, the blank is at 'basis of our ___' and the later occurrence is 30+ words away. For an easy (쉬움) question, this contextual hint is acceptable and pedagogically useful.

Q1-Q3 (ABC): Original words appear elsewhere in fullPassage since it's the same passage. This is inherent to ABC format with a short passage and is flagged as EX-3 warning. Not fixable without changing passage.

Q14: boldest (가장 대담한) is on a different semantic axis (courage vs intelligence). This is intentional per anti-cheese-gate rule to prevent all-synonym-elimination. Students must know brightest means intelligent, not just bright.

verdict: PASS - No HIGH issues. All 3 LOW issues are by design or inherent to format.
